releaseNotes:
• Storage-Only Deletion & Deep History Purge: Free up phone storage from local gallery while keeping the post record and cover thumbnail in the History archive for 1-tap re-download anytime. Permanent history deletion is safely tucked inside an advanced danger zone.
• Modern Glassmorphic Options Bottom Sheet: Replaced old-fashioned black-and-white dialogs with sleek Material 3 bottom sheets featuring post previews, direct status badges, and 1-tap actions.
• Beautiful Welcome / Splash Screen: Ultra-smooth ~850ms entrance animation with brand gradient logo and tagline, seamlessly transitioning to MainActivity.
• Engaging In-App Software Update & Home Screen Banner: Vibrant update assistant with gradient highlight chips, real-time download stats, and proactive automatic Home Screen update notification.
